notes.title: Elfheim - Chapter 1: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42479994/dedb7c122a6b54c27399d65048f8149f6e7ce383.png[/img]

Hello everyone, 

Welcome to Elfheim! A Comic-like Kinect Visual Novel in a fantasy setting filled with all kinds of lewd Elves!
[b]
[h1]Release Date: March 2nd![/h1][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2016350/Elfheim__Chapter_1/

[b]Key Tags:[/b] Fantasy, Elves, Magic, 2DCG, Humor, Slime, Masturbation, Teasing, Grinding, Kissing, X-Ray, Deepthroat, Vaginal Sex, Handjob, Milf, Oral sex, Teasing, Exhibitionism, Big Tits, Small Tits, Milf.

[b]Plot Summary:[/b] In Elfheim, you step into the metaphorical shoes of Informis, the all-mighty and powerful Slime King. Upon landing into an unknown world and losing your strength, you must assume a new form and mingle with the locals while you attempt to regain your former glory. [i](The locals are lewd Elves)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42479994/3c6f42cd703184d277712da4caf3502a73af8e43.png[/img]

Elfheim is a kinetic comic-like adult Visual Novel. We have decided to focus on an abundance of beautiful artworks depicting scenes as they progress (much like a comic would) instead of static character sprites that alter slightly (or not at all) through large chunks of dialogue.

[b]Elfheim - Chapter 1[/b] features:
[list]
[*] Comic-like experience
[*] 160+ images
[*] 22k words
[*] 7 original songs
[/list]
